title: Re-home the PR-body generator off the retired 'vsdd observe' namespace (template + init.rs + install-slice tests)

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
Discovered during #840's telemetry retirement (full corpus reconciliation). The PR-body generator was authored under the retired 'vsdd observe' namespace but is a DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW feature (auto PR body from milestone behavioral contracts), NOT telemetry — so it survives the retirement and needs re-homing, not removal.

BUILT surface touched (why this is a follow-on, not #840 prose):
- templates/.github/workflows/vsdd-observe-pr-body.yml (the deployed workflow; still carries OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* secret refs to strip)
- vsdd-core/src/init.rs:705-706 (include_bytes! deploys it)
- vsdd-core/tests/install_slice_red_gate.rs:525,588,692 (asserts deployment)
- DESIGN-VERIFICATION.md workflow definition (being re-grounded in #840 to mark it re-home-pending)

DECISION NEEDED (SO): the new command surface. Options:
(a) Re-home to a decided command (README/DESIGN prose provisionally used 'vsdd verify pr-body'); rename the template file + init.rs path + 3 test assertions + strip the OTel secrets. Needs the command-surface design + a red-gate.
(b) Keep the filename, only strip OTel + repoint the command internally (smaller change; filename stays vsdd-observe-pr-body.yml which is incoherent long-term).
(c) Retire the pr-body generator entirely if it's not load-bearing (remove template + init deployment + tests).

Recommend (a). Blocks nothing in #840; the #840 prose marks the generator 'surviving, re-home pending #842'. Sequence after #840 lands (own design cycle for the command surface, then Slice implementation + red-gate).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: SCOPE SET (operator 2026-07-31): REMOVE, drop the idea (option 2). vsdd observe was never built; the pr-body scaffolding (template + init.rs deployment + install-slice test assertions) is dead scaffolding + a cargo-cult green test. Delete: templates/.github/workflows/vsdd-observe-pr-body.yml; the include_bytes! + deploy entry in vsdd-core/src/init.rs (~705-706); the install_slice_red_gate.rs assertions (~525,588,692). This is a code+test change with a red-gate, sequenced after #840 lands. The PR-body idea is dropped; if ever wanted it returns as a fresh designed feature.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Adjacent finding from the #826 amendment re-verify (PE-R6): templates/.github/workflows/vsdd-verify.yml:45 invokes 'vsdd verify check --format sarif' — no verify subcommand exists on the binary (surface: init/status/gate); lines 28-30 still wire the retired OTel exporter env. Same unbuilt/retired-namespace class as the observe workflow this issue tracks — fold both template repairs into this re-home.
